function: Two-stage CNN predicting RIS phase shifts with element enabling, and BS precoding, to maximize the EE-SE tradeoff in a PMA-based sparse RIS cell-free system (p. 8).
system: Cell-free MIMO downlink: 5 BSs, 4 users, 2 sparse passive reflecting PMA-based RISs (64 elements), 2 antennas per BS and user; 10 MHz bandwidth, band not stated (p. 9).
method: Two-stage CNN (phase-shift network, then precoding network), unsupervised learning with a power-penalty loss, Adam, 100 epochs, batch 64; no labels (p. 10).
data_channel: Own simulator: correlated Rayleigh BS-user and RIS-user channels, geometric BS-RIS channel, path loss C0 (d/d0)^-k with exponents 2.2, 3.5, 2.8; no dataset or measurements (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained and validated on the same simulated system (train/validation loss, Pmax = 10 dBm, Fig. 11); EE swept over Pmax; no unseen scenario (p. 11).
baselines: Non-learned: alternating optimization (continuous, 1-bit, 2-bit, PMA, regular RIS; Fig. 9, p. 11). Learned: LSTM [21], DNN [49] only in parameters and FLOPs (Table I, p. 9).
metrics: Energy efficiency (bits/J), spectral efficiency, EE-SE tradeoff (weighting beta), training/validation loss, convergence iterations, parameter count, FLOPs (p. 11).
complexity: CNN: O(L^2 NU^2 M^2 NB^2 + R^2 NR^2), AO: O(Io(R^3 NR^3 + Ia M^2 NB^2 L^2)); Table I: 250,000 parameters, 3.81e7 FLOPs (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 4: "are characterized by the correlated Rayleigh fading"; p. 9 gives its own path loss C0(d/d0)^-k and correlation matrices "obtained by a similar way as in [47], [48]": custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "The loss function for the training and the validation sets" of the CNN (Fig. 11, Pmax = 10 dBm) is a held-out part of the same data; Fig. 9 only sweeps Pmax. No other scenario, antenna count, user count or adaptation is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "lower parameter count and inference complexity" - LSTM [21] and DNN [49] are compared only on parameters and FLOPs (Table I), not on EE or SE; the CNN's EE (Fig. 9, p. 11) is compared only with non-learned alternating optimization.
q4_support: p. 9: "network has an approximate complexity of" O(L^2 NU^2 M^2 NB^2 + ...) for the CNN; Table I on the same page lists its parameter count and FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 9: "As for the channel model, it is assumed that" angles and path loss are drawn by the authors; no code or data link, DOI or availability statement in pp. 1-13, and no public or measured dataset.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. The main method is a classical alternating optimization (LDR, MCQT, PDS) with a closed-form SE; included because the proposed two-stage CNN (abstract; Section V) is a learned component that outputs the RIS phase shifts with element enabling and the precoder. Area 3. RIS is passive reflecting, PMA-based and sparse. q3 = 0 because LSTM [21] and DNN [49] enter only Table I (parameters, FLOPs), not EE or SE results. Number of training samples and carrier frequency are not stated. Table I and Figs. 9-11 read from the page image.
